note: The EEPROM payload is in emulator byte order (the order mGBA, VBA-M and a raw .sav use; text such as "ADLEZBGA" reads backwards per 8 bytes), not the GameShark order, so mGBA's import (which reverses each 8-byte block) scrambles it; taken as is instead, mGBA reads it: no language prompt, and the game announces the Four Swords sword beams the save has unlocked.
